objs.name: document
objs.description: Document managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations and workflow participant.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations and workflow participant.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations and workflow participant.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute mentioned with releaser for translation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when validity expires.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an invalidated document is archived.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute affecting e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute affecting distribution of acknowledgement workflow task when the next version is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type used to differentiate documents and selected when creating a new document.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for a document type.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration defined for each document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: New information object attached in the system to create documents or add information to a document.

objs.name: document_properties
objs.description: Properties of a document where metadata, attributes, authorizations and workflow participants are maintained.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or customer-specific metadata maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents already in the system can be linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents already in the system can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents already in the system can be linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement a document with additional information that is released and published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing document that belongs to a document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: System user involved in reading, authoring, reviewing, releasing, translating or receiving notifications.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned to authorizations, distribution or workflow participant attributes.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign read and change rights and distribution.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group that retains read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role whose users can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role or participant that signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Role with additional personal change rights and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role that checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role responsible for the document itself and its content and for deciding distribution to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task processed by workflow participants.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: E-mail used to inform users of workflow tasks, status, change proposals, validity extension, override, release or acknowledgement requests.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity is nearing expiry.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request for invalidating or overriding a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to document distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard filled by document distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report for documents, instructions, workflow status or acknowledgements.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated language-dependent version of a released document.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: The corresponding document type is selected when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: A document template is selected when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: A pure object cover is created.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents are uploaded to the object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents are generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: open_properties_editing
evts.description: Attaching an object opens the properties editing of the document.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Document properties are described and maintained.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata are maintained automatically or by the user.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using an implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: The document is saved.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: A saved document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: The current version is displayed on the web as a PDF.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Changes to released documents result in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Workflow participants are allocated in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is modified.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Attachment content is modified.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Attachment is marked for archiving and archived with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: The three-step release process is started by one of the co-authors or the author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator workflow step with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers complete the review task for the document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser completes the release task positively and finally releases the document.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: A rejection during review cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: A rejection during release cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system informs involved users by e-mail notification.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with electronic signatures.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: A valid released document is revised and a new version is automatically created in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An employee with author rights creates a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation and creates a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: check_validity_extension
evts.description: The relevant users check whether the document remains valid, needs revision or must be invalidated.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared for a document.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted after additional validity or release of a revised version.

evts.name: update_valid_until
evts.description: The document valid until date is updated by the default value.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for processing the request for AKS is started automatically.

evts.name: check_request_for_aks
evts.description: The creator of the request checks the request and the document.

evts.name: review_aks
evts.description: Reviewers review the AKS.

evts.name: approve_aks
evts.description: Releasers approve the AKS.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Documents and attachments are declared invalid and archived.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Authorizations are revoked at user group and person level, except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created and the corresponding document is selected.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for reactivation is started automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The creator of the request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is revalidated and a new version is created.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups and persons are assigned to the distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned user groups are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned user groups are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of the document.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: The author team receives notification when all persons have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Role-specific dashboards are filled using distribution groups in the distribution list.

evts.name: select_document_from_dashboard
evts.description: A document is selected from the document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_detail
evts.description: Detailed information such as attachments, additional information, referenced documents and language versions is displayed.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: A report evaluates documents, instructions, current workflow status or acknowledgements depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is released with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients is specified.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: A new document is created in a client for local additions.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: A reference to the original document is created from the local document.
